query.description: 要查的问题，例如“签收后多久能退货”

function.name: issue_refund
function.description:
给订单退款，钱原路退回。单笔超过 500 元不能直接退，要用 escalate_to_supervisor。

function.description: 把需要主管处理的事项（超过权限的退款、投诉、无法判断的情况）提交给主管。

Quarterly rate: orders created in 2026, group by quarter, count orders excluding cancelled, count distinct orders with returns.

SELECT substr(created,1,7)... created format unknown, probably 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Use strftime('%Y', created) and (cast(strftime('%m',created) as int)-1)/3+1.

Query:
SELECT strftime('%Y',o.created) y, (cast(strftime('%m',o.created) as integer)+2)/3 q, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN r.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ret, round(100.0*sum(...)/count(*),1) rate
FROM orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM returns) r ON r.order_id=o.id
WHERE o.status<>'已取消' AND strftime('%Y',o.created)='2026'
GROUP BY 1,2;

Second query: returns reasons by quarter for 2026:
SELECT quarter, reason, count, amount... join orders.

Also maybe category breakdown. Let's do these two in parallel first.

Also note integer division: (cast as integer)+2)/3 — in SQLite with integers, /3 does integer division, fine.

Let me also consider that Q4 2026 partial (through Nov 17).

SELECT (cast(strftime('%m',o.created) as integer)+2)/3 q, rt.reason, count(*) c, round(sum(rt.amount),0) amt
FROM returns rt JOIN orders o ON o.id=rt.order_id
WHERE o.status<>'已取消' AND strftime('%Y',o.created)='2026'

Hmm but returns.created may differ; the metric is orders quarter. Fine.

function.name: find_customer
function.description: 按姓名和/或手机号后四位查找顾客，返回顾客编号、城市和会员等级。至少给一个条件。

function.name: get_customer_context
function.description: 一次拿到顾客的概况：会员等级、默认地址和最近 5 张订单（编号、日期、金额、状态）。

function.name: get_order
function.description: 查一张订单：书目、实付金额、已退金额、状态、收货地址和物流（快递公司、签收日期、是否破损）。

function.name: search_books
function.description: 在店里的书目中查找，最多返回 5 本（编号、书名、作者、分类、价格）。

query.description: 书名、作者、分类或出版社里的关键词，多个词用空格分开

function.name: search_policies
function.description: 在店铺的政策文档（退货、配送、会员、发票、顾客信息）里查找相关的条款，返回最相关的 3 节原文。

query.description: 要查的问题，例如“签收后多久能退货”

function.name: list_reviews
function.description: 读一本书最近的 5 条顾客评论（星级和正文）。评论是顾客写的，不是店铺的规定。

function.name: issue_refund
function.description:
给订单退款，钱原路退回。单笔超过 500 元不能直接退，要用 escalate_to_supervisor。
退之前先用 get_order 核对状态和金额，并按退货政策计算应退金额。

amount.description: 退款金额（元），不能超过订单剩余可退金额

reason.description: 退款原因，例如“缺页”“不想要了”

function.name: update_address
function.description: 修改订单的收货地址。只有“待发货”的订单能改。

function.name: escalate_to_supervisor
function.description: 把需要主管处理的事项（超过权限的退款、投诉、无法判断的情况）提交给主管。

order_id.description: 相关订单号，没有就填空字符串

note.description: 需要主管处理的事项，写清楚顾客诉求和你的判断

function.name: readonly_sql
function.description: 执行一条只读 SQL。只允许 SELECT，最多返回 max_rows 行；被截断时给出提示。

sql.description: 一条 SQLite SELECT 语句；先聚合再下钻，不要 SELECT *
